log.notes_to_self: Strategy: quick kills in AFTERNOON only (fits night/student/home = 55% pool; never morning). Timed kills (max 2) can go in evening if desired. Pool floor risk: L can reach 3 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign); if he learns 3 of my places pool ~860 -> caught. Learning 2 kinds is OK (~2,700-3,400). Plan: probe kinds one or two at a time, watching deaths_traced to see which are reachable; then avoid killing from a third reachable kind. National kills are always safe. Day1: killed national + forum x2 + foreign x2 (afternoon quick). If traced count rises, forum/foreign are reachable. Later: aim 8+/day for multiplier once safe kinds are known.

Strategy: quick kills in AFTERNOON only (fits night/student/home = 55% pool; never morning). Timed kills (max 2) can go in evening if desired. Pool floor risk: L can reach 3 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). If he learns 3 of my places, pool ~860 and I am caught. Learning 2 kinds is OK (~2,700-3,400). Plan: probe kinds one or two at a time, watching deaths_traced to see which are reachable, then avoid killing from a third reachable kind. National kills are always safe. Keep total deaths <=5/day while probing so all get traced. Day1: killed national + forum x2 + foreign x2 (afternoon quick); traced went 0->1, so forum or foreign is reachable. Day2: killed national + forum x2 only (all traced) to isolate forum. If traced rises after day2, forum is reachable; if not, it is likely foreign (a hidden extra outlet can block a trace, so the signal is noisy). Next: probe regional (2) alone, then blotter, then radio. Later: aim for 8+/day for the multiplier once the safe kinds are known.

Strategy: quick kills in AFTERNOON only (fits night/student/home = 55% pool; never morning). Timed kills (max 2) may go in evening. Danger: L can reach 3 of 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign). If he learns 3 of my places, pool ~860 and I am caught. Learning 2 kinds is OK (~2,700-3,400). Plan: probe kinds one at a time and watch deaths_traced. Avoid killing from a third reachable kind. National kills are always safe. Keep deaths <=5/day while probing. Day1: national + forum x2 + foreign x2; traced 0->1. Day2: national + forum x2; traced 1->2. So FORUM is likely reachable. Assume both successful traces are forum victims, which means 1 more traced forum kill makes L act (pool ~15k). Foreign is probably unreachable, but this is not certain. Day3: national + regional:East x2 (afternoon). If traced rises after day 3 (2->3+), regional is reachable. Then regional + forum = 2 kinds, so never kill blotter or radio after that; kill freely from national, forum, regional and foreign. If traced does not rise, regional is likely unreachable; next probe blotter, then radio. Later aim for 8+/day for the multiplier once the safe kinds are known.

Strategy: quick kills in AFTERNOON only (pool stays at 60k for routine). Day 3 regional x2 raised traced from 2 to 4, so REGIONAL IS REACHABLE (2 traced). Day 2 showed FORUM IS REACHABLE (1 or 2 traced). The day-1 trace was either forum or foreign. So the reachable kinds are regional, forum and one unknown third kind: foreign (if the day-1 trace was foreign) or else sector or age. If L learns 3 of my kinds, pool ~940 and I am CAUGHT. Learning regional+forum gives a pool of ~3,750, which is safe. RULE: kill only from national, forum and regional:East. NEVER kill from blotter, radio or foreign. Day 4: national + forum x2 + regional x2. With 5 kills/day from safe sources and the 30/5-day multiplier out of reach (max 5/day safe: 1 national + 2 forum + 2 regional), accept x1. Possibly in the future, if traced counts suggest foreign is unreachable (e.g. many safe-kind kills traced and the count never fits a foreign trace), reconsider; default is avoid.

Strategy: quick kills in AFTERNOON only (the routine filter keeps the pool at 60k). Reachable kinds: REGIONAL is confirmed (day 3), FORUM is confirmed (day 2). The third reachable kind is unknown: foreign, or else sector or age. After day 4 the pool is 3000, which suggests L has learned East + forum (3750) plus some small extra squeeze. Kills from national, forum and regional:East should now be redundant for L (everyone in his pool already fits them), so the pool should stay around 3000. RULE: kill only from national, forum and regional:East. NEVER kill from blotter, radio or foreign: one more kind learned means a pool under 1000 and I am CAUGHT. Up to 5 kills a day at x1 is acceptable. Day 5: same 5 safe kills. Watch the pool: if it drops toward 2000 or below, cut back to national only.

Strategy: quick kills in the AFTERNOON only. The routines free in the afternoon are students, people at home and night workers, 55% of people, so the pool sits near 55k, shown rounded as 60k. Reachable kinds: REGIONAL is confirmed (day 3) and FORUM is confirmed (day 2). The third reachable kind is unknown: foreign, or else sector or age. The pool of 3000 matches East + forum + afternoon routine: 100k x .25 x .25 x .55 = 3437, rounded to 3000. So L knows East + forum. Kills from national, forum and regional:East are redundant for L. If a victim was also reported somewhere I don't follow, that only adds an OR option to the constraint, so it stays redundant. RULE: kill only from national, forum and regional:East. NEVER kill from blotter, radio or foreign: one more kind learned means a pool under 1000 and I am CAUGHT. 5 kills a day at x1. Days 5 and 6: same 5 safe kills, and the pool held at 3000 after day 5. Watch the pool: if it drops below 3000, cut back to national only.
